02 // VERIFIED VENTURE PORTFOLIO

OUR SOCIAL STARTUPS

Sponsors back proven student enterprises with measurable outcomes. Our active portfolio gives corporate partners four distinct, high-credibility impact verticals immediately.

TERRA-PLAST & THE GOOD POD

PATENT PROVISIONAL FILING

A completely biodegradable bio-plastic derived from wasted potato starch, launched with B2C proof-of-concept The Good Pod—an immediate fit for ESG, circular packaging, and sustainability sponsors.

NATIONAL RECOGNITION

2024 Top 4 Finalist at Enactus Canada Nationals & Runner-Up in the Canadian Tire Corp. Environmental Sustainability Challenge.

03 // STRATEGIC GROWTH BLUEPRINT BY EMILIE FAUL

THREE PILLARS & 90-DAY PLAN

Expanding beyond business majors, converting ad-hoc fundraising into annual impact tiers, and deploying monthly impact telemetry across every Enactus TMU venture.

CROSS-FACULTY TALENT PIPELINE

Complex social enterprises demand multidisciplinary builders from day one. We intentionally recruit beyond TRSM into Engineering & Architectural Science, Science, The Creative School, and Community Services.

  • Cross-Faculty Recruitment: Technical researchers for Terra-Plast from Engineering & Science; UI/UX designers and storytellers from The Creative School; operators from Community Services and TRSM.
  • Member-to-Founder Venture Sprint: Semester-based sprint tied directly to credit courses (ENT 401, ENT 727, BUS 720) and TMUEI incubation & legal clinics.
  • Video-First Recruiting Reels: Documentary short-form founder spotlights across Terra-Plast, BITS, SMU, and Traits Toronto ahead of every intake cycle.

KEY OUTCOMES

Deeper Technical & Creative Bench Ventures gain dedicated engineering, R&D, and design execution alongside business strategy.
Multi-Term Retention Academic credit integration and TMUEI resources keep high-performing builders engaged year-round.

TIERED ANNUAL SPONSORSHIP ENGINE

Shifting from one-off event asks to structured Annual Impact Partnerships aligned with corporate CSR mandates, ESG reporting, and early-career campus recruiting.

  • Four Defined Annual Tiers: Title Impact Partner, Venture Growth Sponsor, Competition & Exposition Partner, and Community & In-Kind Partner.
  • Live Digital Partner Prospectus: Replacing static PDF decks with a live web portal featuring real-time venture KPIs and direct partner consultation booking.
  • Alumni & Advisory Warm-Intro Pipeline: Activating Enactus TMU alumni, faculty advisors, and TMUEI leadership for direct introductions to CSR & ESG directors.

KEY OUTCOMES

Recurring Multi-Year Revenue Stabilizes venture seed grants and Regional/National Exposition travel budgets.
Turnkey Corporate ROI Quarterly impact reports and video case studies give sponsors ready-to-share proof.

UNIFIED IMPACT DASHBOARD & EXPO

Monthly Triple-Bottom-Line tracking powers both sponsor reporting and continuous audit readiness for Regional and National Enactus competitions.

  • Central Monthly Telemetry: Tracks beneficiaries reached, workshop & community hours, venture revenue reinvested, and environmental plastic diversion.
  • Elevated Enactus TMU EXPO Demo Day: Premier sponsor-attended showcase with live venture pitches, partner networking booths, and produced recap films.
  • Quarterly Sponsor-Judged Mock Pitches: Corporate partners and alumni stress-test financials and decks to build on our Top-4 national finish.

KEY OUTCOMES

Audit-Ready Competition Data Eliminates last-minute data scrambles before Regional and National Expositions.
Signature Renewal Moment Turns EXPO into the flagship annual touchpoint driving multi-year partner renewals.
